# Security policy

OCamleer is a static website, built with Jekyll and hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Supported versions

Only the live site, <https://vontanne.github.io/ocamleer/>, and the latest commit on the `master` branch are supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't report security problems in public issues. Report them privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/vontanne/ocamleer/security/advisories/new). If you can't use it, email [ocamleer@gmail.com](mailto:ocamleer@gmail.com).

Describe the problem, where you found it, and how to reproduce it.

## Scope

In scope:

- the code in this repository: includes, styles, and configuration;
- the GitHub Actions workflow;
- the dependency versions pinned in `Gemfile.lock`.

Out of scope:

- GitHub and GitHub Pages: report to the [GitHub Security Bug Bounty](https://bounty.github.com/);
- the Minimal Mistakes theme itself: report to [its repository](https://github.com/mmistakes/minimal-mistakes);
- errors in articles: [open an issue](https://github.com/vontanne/ocamleer/issues/new/choose).
